_comment: Which Unreal Content folders each island owns, for tools/streaming/dsb_measure.py. Paths are relative to the project's Content folder (/Game/<path>). An island with no content_dirs keeps the placement-count estimate. Owners: fill in your row when you know where your island's assets live.

islands.note: disk pinned to BIP1 packet bytes with owner consent; RAM remains the placement-count ESTIMATE

pin.basis: sum of the 67 BIP1 R2 packet byte counts (28 terrain + 39 prop libs), ceil to KiB; FILE-ONLY
pin.source_acceptance: R2 manifest: blender-team READY 50054/50055; buffffff acceptance 50079. The consent above records the original R1 file-only pin; these totals follow the accepted R2 source.

islands.note: Content/Hephaestus holds only the sublevel map and one material; meshes live in shared folders, owner to list them
not owned by disk-saver; keeps the estimate until oddsreaper lists or confirms its folders (pootscoot plan review 47919)
